name: [UPDATE!] Cruise Line Tycoon
desc:
Welcome to Cruise Line Tycoon 🚢
Dive in to a new grid-based ship building & management game where you are in control of your own cruise line. 

How to play❓
Build rooms, entertainment & amenities to keep your guests satisfied 🛠️
Stock up on fuel & supplies before exploring the vast ocean 🌊
Hire crew, expand your fleet & create your dream cruise ship empire! 🤑

Beta release ⚠️
Before you play, please note: this game is in Beta, so expect minor bugs and balance inconsistencies.

Latest update [V2.2.0] Titanic, modular kitchens & DJ booth ⚓
Previous update [V2.1.0] Teamwork, new Celeste Class & legacy ships 👥
